title: Like a video game
body: I absolutely love how this app works, it makes you think that your trying to complete challenges every single day, just like you do in a video game, it’s so fun and makes it way less challenging to exercise when you think of it that way.
author: the man who is always right

title: Ask before stopping
body:
Please ask before stopping exercise! 
When you push X End on the apple watch it should ask "are you sure?" Or something like that so you don't accidentally stop. 
I hope this will be fixed.
author: fitnessinga
